races.title: United States Representative, New Mexico Congressional District 1
races.overview: Represents the voters of Albuquerque, NM in the U.S. House of Representatives. Manages federal lawmaking, national budget appropriations, constituent advocacy, and federal agency oversight.

candidates.name: Melanie Stansbury
candidates.desc: Democratic candidate focusing on healthcare access, education funding, public infrastructure, and environmental policy for Albuquerque, NM.

candidates.name: Steve Jones
candidates.desc: Republican candidate advocating for fiscal discipline, tax reduction, economic growth, public safety, and streamlined regulation in New Mexico.

candidates.name: State Senator (Albuquerque, NM)

candidates.name: State Representative (Albuquerque, NM)
candidates.desc: Focuses on local job creation, public safety, public school funding, and constituent advocacy.
